record.title: Cyprus Ledra Street pedestrian crossing pandemic closure
record.scope: Ledra Street / Lokmaci crossing of the Green Line; de facto division, not an internationally recognised interstate frontier
record.direction: Both directions at the specified pedestrian crossing
record.exceptions: Alternative crossings and special categories existed in the wider regime; not evidence of unrestricted Ledra Street use. Health documents required after reopening.
record.imposing_authority: Republic of Cyprus authorities; later coordinated reopening with Turkish Cypriot authorities
record.enforcement: European Commission retrospective confirms suspension and reopening; local report documents barrier removal before reopening; June 4 local extract reports actual opening.
record.consequences: Local reporting describes interrupted personal contacts. No quantified causal estimate is made.
record.official_rationale: Republic of Cyprus authorities cited prevention of COVID-19 transmission.
record.context: One of four crossing points initially suspended. Other Green Line crossings and population groups followed different timelines. The 2021 agreement harmonised requirements across the divide.
record.uncertainty: The interval applies only to ordinary pedestrian access at Ledra Street, not the whole Green Line. Reopening was conditional. Contemporary reporting places barricades at 06:00 on 29 February 2020; no claim is made that every exemption or intermediate access arrangement is reconstructed.

historical.duration_note: Calendar-date difference to the stated partial reopening for the specified category and crossing; not exact hours or universal closure
